children: Iron ore prices are lower in early Asian trade. Demand remains subdued on weak steel-mill profitability, say Anliang Futures analysts in a note. Port inventories continue to build, while steel mills' imported stocks decline, showing winter restocking has yet to start, they add. Elevated inventories are also weighing on prices, while improving producer prices are providing some support, they say. Investors should watch for macroeconomy policy shifts and the Fed's decisions on interest rates, they say. The most actively traded January iron ore contract on the Dalian Commodity Exchange is 1.1% lower at 649 yuan a ton. (jiahui.huang@wsj.com; @ivy_jiahuihuang)
